# TakeoutFix

TakeoutFix is an open-source utility for restoring metadata from Google Takeout photo/video exports.

## What it does
- Matches Google Takeout media files with their JSON sidecar metadata files.
- Restores capture dates, timestamps, GPS coordinates, and related EXIF metadata.
- Runs locally on the user's device (web edition in browser and desktop edition for Windows/macOS/Linux).

## Product pages
- Home: https://takeoutfix.pages.dev/
- Web restore tool: https://takeoutfix.pages.dev/tool
- Restore guide: https://takeoutfix.pages.dev/restore-data
- Guides hub: https://takeoutfix.pages.dev/guides
- Desktop download: https://takeoutfix.pages.dev/download
